text: The port names the string parameter url, parses a separate nsIURI for predictRemoteTypeForURI and still sends the original string to fixupAndLoadURIString. It supplies browser.documentGlobal as prediction context and preserves the existing principal fallback and remote-presence decision. Actual request and content-tab callers pass strings, but the inspected wrapper does not prove all fixup inputs or the external engine predictor have equivalent behavior. This is a local type/name and call-boundary fact, not a global naming rule or process-isolation guarantee.
title: MailE10SUtils predicts with a parsed URI but loads the original URL string
